skills.name: Composite - Drill hole
skills.description: Drill a hole in an object using a power drill and drill bit.

steps.activity: Position the power drill at the drilling location on the object_to_drill
Pull the trigger of the power drill
Push the drill bit of the power drill into the object_to_drill
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

examples: Pre-drill holes in roof flashing with a power drill

skills.name: Composite - Hammer an object into a surface
skills.description: Use a hammer repeatedly to drive an object into a surface.

steps.activity: Determine the position on the target_surface where the object_to_hammer will be hammered
Position the object_to_hammer on the target_surface
Position the hammer near the head of the object_to_hammer
Swing the hammer to hit the object_to_hammer and drive it into the surface
steps.category: Swing arm while holding an object

examples: Hammer a bolster to break mortar from a brick joint
Hammer a nail through roofing material into a roof
